prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a premium dimensional floating ghost FRONT product photograph of the exact Black WT0092 quarter-zip top in image 1. Image 2 is ONLY a reference for realistic filled, worn garment volume, light-gray studio backdrop and floating shadow; do not include leggings. Show ONLY the quarter-zip top, front-facing, suspended naturally with softly shaped shoulders, torso and gently bent empty sleeves as though worn by an invisible person. Preserve image 1's actual stand mock neck, quarter-length center zipper closed to the collar, fitted regular hip-length cut, set-in sleeves, long straight sleeve ends with thumbhole slits, flat hem and real seams. Fabric is lightweight smooth matte 91% polyester/9% spandex performance knit, 165 gsm, with subtle realistic folds and fine texture. Match the precise WHITE G/RED A monogram silhouette, colors, wearer-left chest placement and discreet size in image 1: saved print 2.00 by 1.80 inches. Keep the logo's width approximately half the horizontal distance from the zipper to the logo center, following the reference proportions. Natural hollow collar opening and empty sleeve cuffs, clean dimensional garment silhouette, evenly lit black fabric with readable details, soft floating shadow on a seamless light neutral-gray studio. One 1024x1536 portrait product photograph, whole collar, hem and sleeve ends visible with balanced margins. No human, mannequin parts, hands, legs, shoes, hanger, hood, drawstrings, ribbed waistband, wording or extra graphics.

Professional full-length activewear catalog photograph of adult brand model Molly. Image 1 is Molly's exact identity reference: preserve her face, natural skin texture, dark low ponytail and compact athletic build. Image 2 is the exact Black WT0092 mock-neck quarter-zip top; image 3 is the exact Black WB0025 leggings. Dress Molly in these actual Black garments and plain white training sneakers. Match the quarter zip's stand mock neck, center zipper closed up to the collar, set-in long sleeves, thumbhole cuffs, fitted hip-length untucked hem and smooth matte lightweight 165 gsm stretch performance knit. Match image 2's WHITE G/RED A GA monogram on the wearer's LEFT chest, saved 2.00 by 1.80 inches, with width about half the horizontal distance from zipper to logo center. Preserve its precise small silhouette and placement, not oversized. Leggings have a high waistband, smooth fitted legs and flat ankle hems, with a completely plain front. Molly faces forward, smiling warmly, relaxed weight on one leg, one hand resting lightly at her outer hip below the chest logo and the other arm relaxed; wear the thumbhole cuffs naturally. The top falls over the leggings waistband with realistic garment lengths and no exposed midriff. Neutral gray seamless studio, soft even commercial lighting, natural fabric folds, complete head and both shoes visible with margins. One 1024x1536 portrait photograph. No accessories, text overlays, extra graphics, pockets or stripes.
